caption: Reference memory for a graduation-design IP system that turns chemistry education into an Element Intelligence Agency universe. The opening system cover uses a custom experimental Chinese title, electric blue block geometry, playful element mascots and a lab scene to create an immediately recognizable science-communication identity.
positive_aesthetic_notes: scientific concepts are personified into a coherent mascot system instead of decorative icons
the title, blue geometric block and lab scene create a clear first-viewport identity anchor
bold color and childlike energy are controlled by a manual-like presentation frame
negative_failure_notes: do not copy the original mascots, title lettering or scene composition
avoid making chemistry symbols into random cute stickers without a system role
do not let bright colors erase hierarchy or text legibility
text_accuracy_notes: Visible Chinese and English titles must be supplied exactly by the user or kept as placeholders; never invent chemical names or pseudo-science labels.
layout_notes: Use a strong cover anchor, then introduce mascot taxonomy, behavior rules, scene rules and application proof in that order.

caption: Expression-pack reference where each mascot behavior becomes a repeatable communication unit. Small stickers, reaction words, sound effects and graphic bursts are arranged as a behavior taxonomy, letting the IP move from educational board to social-media language.
positive_aesthetic_notes: extension logic is behavior-based, not only asset duplication
speech bursts, question marks and action marks give the science IP a lively emotional register
the sheet proves that mascot design can become a reusable communication library
negative_failure_notes: avoid uncontrolled meme clutter without categories
do not generate illegible mini text or random internet slang
do not mix unrelated character styles inside one IP family
text_accuracy_notes: Reaction words should be short, exact and editable; use placeholders for uncertain copy.
layout_notes: Group stickers by emotion, action, warning, experiment and reward rather than scattering them evenly.

caption: Dark neon information-visualization board memory: black intelligence-board field, luminous blue-purple title, periodic-table inspired icon tiles, chemical object cutaways, charts, portraits, diagram rails and high-contrast data modules. The style is loud and futuristic, but still separated into named modules.
positive_aesthetic_notes: black field makes neon scientific data feel like an intelligence archive
periodic-table tiles become a modular visual grammar for many content types
bright illustration, data charts and typographic rails are separated by panel boundaries
negative_failure_notes: do not use neon glow as a substitute for information hierarchy
avoid mixing too many micro diagrams without a central reading path
do not hallucinate chemical formulas, portraits, legends or scientific claims
text_accuracy_notes: Chemical names, equations, labels and legend values are high-risk; they require source text or should remain abstract placeholders.
layout_notes: Start with one dark title zone, then use a grid of evidence modules, large diagram anchor, data rail and application proof strip.

caption: Application proof memory for translating the science IP and infovis system into books, card sets, cushions, badges, keychains and packaging structures. The bold visual system keeps recognition by repeating electric blue, violet, mascot silhouettes, modular tiles and black-neon science panels across different materials.
positive_aesthetic_notes: application proof shows the system is not only a poster but a usable product ecology
card and book formats make information replayable and collectible
the same color and mascot grammar survives across soft goods, paper goods and display props
negative_failure_notes: do not add merchandise unless it proves a system rule
avoid product mockups that ignore print scale, edge safety or material readability
do not copy the original product photos or exact object arrangement
text_accuracy_notes: Product names, card titles and package copy need exact editable text; uncertain small copy should be represented as neutral blocks.
layout_notes: Show applications as a proof chain: book or card logic first, then soft goods, small objects, packaging, and exhibition booth.

caption: Full exhibition-board memory for an experimental science IP system: left-to-right evidence flow from brand idea and character family to expression pack, illustration scenes, infovis boards, book design, packaging dielines and physical exhibition proof. The board is dense but works because each cluster has a named function.
positive_aesthetic_notes: the final board proves concept, visual system, information design and application output in one controlled field
high density is accepted because clusters have distinct tasks and scale changes
physical exhibition documentation validates that the visual system can leave the screen
negative_failure_notes: avoid compressing every asset to equal size
do not use density as an excuse for missing hierarchy
do not include watermarks, platform UI or source-page artifacts as design elements
text_accuracy_notes: Use real headings and source-safe placeholders; no pseudo-Chinese filler or broken typography.
layout_notes: Reserve the largest area for the system overview, then allocate smaller modules for stickers, cards, books, packaging and exhibition scene proof.
